🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 24, 2026

Moon, in Aries, holds a conjunction to Saturn, in its fall in the same sign. Two fire signs looking at each other: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Cardinal fire: beginning and paying are one act. It has stood two weeks; by now the cost is known.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you from Scorpio, the sign that suits it least. From Scorpio, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Moon in Aries opens a gap you have to step into. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Mercury left Libra four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, moves through Aries unannounced. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Cardinal water: the opening move is the cheap one. The square to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Aries, and what you hold finds words unforced. Fixed fire holds, and holding asks nothing back. Sun has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Sun in Scorpio makes room for you, and then waits. Mutable earth keeps two accounts, and both balance. The hold Venus had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon faces you from Aries, holding the other figures. Cardinal air starts and is invoiced for it. Retrograde since four weeks ago, Venus is still re-reading.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water holds until owning and being coincide. Four weeks ago Mars was still in Cancer: the ground has moved.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Aries, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Aries, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth opens the file, and the file has a price. A week ago Saturn was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you and is weak in Aries: the grip tightens too soon. From Aries, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed air keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. It arrived inside the last seven days.
